title: Manual Therapy in Patients With Asthma
brief_summary: Physical therapists have traditionally included various forms of manual therapy among the therapeutic approaches to respiratory conditions. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of diaphragmatic stretching technique on pulmonary ventilation, rig bage excursion and spirometric values in patients diagnosed with asthma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ranging between 18 and 45 years.
* Diagnosis of asthma.
* No exacerbations during last month.

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of spine surgery.
* Diabetes, neurological or a cardiovascular disease.
* Spine deformities and use of orthopedic devices.
